name: comparator-memory
description: History-dependent switching-boundary shift of the DR-0001 latch: the fourth decision's input threshold after three +50 mV conditioning strobes (history P) minus after three -50 mV strobes (history N), both histories in one netlist and one simulator invocation. CHARACTERIZATION, NOT COMPLIANCE: no specification row is added, changed or claimed.
not_a_harness_manifest: Deliberately NOT named tb.json: sim/harness (run_corners.py) discovers tb.json, and this bench is driven by `python3 sim/run_memory.py` through klt sim on the batch fleet because the paired search needs one request per search round.
reference_circuit: memory.circuit.spice (nominal, round 1, uniform -50 mV bracket low end; drift-guarded by sim/kltsim/tests/test_memory.py)
dut: sim/dut.json (comparator-dr0001, provenance schematic), inlined verbatim with its sha256 in every body
stimulus_reference: sim/comparator-regeneration/testbench/tb_regeneration.spice clock: 10 ns high, 30 ns period (unchanged, not edited)

histories.N: -50 mV x 3 strobes then the identical probe

decision: (V(dout)-V(doutb))/VDD sampled 9 ns after the fourth rising edge

classification.resolved_wrong_polarity: resolved with sign opposing the nonzero probe
